title: ** !'M DONE **
description: For the days when my brain is the most exhausting place to be. Running on absolute empty, tired of pretending I’m fine, and completely crushed by a weight no one else even notices. I am quietly holding back the tears that burn. I just have zero energy left to explain what hurts.
